resources.string: Lets RemoteScroll perform swipes and taps on the screen when you press buttons on your Bluetooth media remote, so you can scroll TikTok without touching the screen. RemoteScroll only reacts to the Next, Previous and Play/Pause keys. It reads the screen only when you ask it to save a video, to find the TikTok Save button, and never stores or sends anything.

1. Enable the accessibility service.
2. Start the remote service.
3. Open TikTok, YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels and use your Bluetooth remote:

• Next: next video (swipe up)
• Previous: previous video (swipe down)
• Hold Next: volume up
• Hold Previous: volume down
• Play/Pause: pause/resume
• Hold Play/Pause: 1 beep = like, 2 beeps = pocket lock on/off, 3 beeps = save. Let go after the beeps you want.
• Or, in Press count style: 2 presses = like, 3 = pocket lock, 4 = save, hold = pocket lock (or like or save, your choice).

Pocket lock: the screen goes black and ignores touches, but TikTok keeps playing and your remote keeps working. Put the phone in your pocket or face down. To unlock, hold a finger on the screen for 2 seconds, or use the pocket lock action on the remote (2 beeps).

Do not press the power button: a real lock pauses TikTok and Android blocks remote control behind the lock screen.
